notes.title: Anomaly Hunter (Free Demo) - sci-fi hidden object puzzler about time-travelling detective, Q4 2020
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/4464c0426ed107262061a73f6edcb3ff41c11eff.png[/img][/url]

[b]Anomaly Hunter[/b] - sci-fi hidden object puzzler about time-traveling detective.
This is first game by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/pub/hook][b]Hook Games[/b][/url] (ex Konstructors), so we would really appreciate your support.

Play as STID (Space & Time Integrity Department) detective, whose role is to find & fix time anomalies, which cause a lot of trouble all over the universe.

Why do they appear, who is hiding behind all of this - simple accident or evil villain? That's a mystery to solve.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/d50b2b7cb4e876ae4d33cdb4e110e73087e7b4e1.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]15 original detailed worlds
    [*]Over 3 hours of fascinating gameplay
    [*]1000+ unique characters and objects, each with its story to tell
    [*]English, Chinese, German, Spanish, Ukrainian & Russian localizations
    [*]Gazillion of Easter eggs, most of them you won't find anyway ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
[/list]

[h1]Play free Demo & Wishlist:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/

[i]Your best,
Hook Games[/i]

notes.title: Play for Free - Nonogram, Master's Legacy.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30909774/bfd52f0edc950454ebc7b924d95e581894afc74a.png[/img]

[i] Nonograms, also known as Picross or Griddlers, are picture logic puzzles in which cells in a grid must be colored or left blank according to numbers at the side of the grid to reveal a hidden picture. [/i] © Wiki

[h1][b]Master's Legacy[/b][/h1]

Excellent attempt in a world of Nonogram/Picross puzzles. Galore of levels, multiple game modes along with level editor & workshop would never disappoint any puzzle fan.

[h1][b]Play for Free[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/742500/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy/

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Totally free - Starter Pack, Community Levels & Level Editor are available for everybody.
[*] Gorgeous Starter Pack - perfect 15 Nonogram levels to get you started and tease your brain for more adventure.
[*] Multiple DLC's with different game modes and level styles.
[*] Completed all levels? Don't worry! We have an endless list of user-made paintings, you'll never feel lonely.
[*] You should love to paint, do you? Go on and try our awesome level editor (up to 100x100 size), show those impostors who is the Greatest One here!
[*] Art design - clean and beautiful.
[*] Relaxing ambient soundtracks will keep your mind sharp and focused.
[/list]

[h1]Bought a game? Leave review![/h1]

Just want to remind you that your reviews are really important for us:
[olist]
[*] They help us better understand what you expect from a game, so we can improve it
[*] Reviews boost game visibility among Steam, which gives us more sales and we can make more cool games in the future :)
[/olist]

You can leave review [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/742500/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy/][b]here[/b][/url].


[h1][b]Magnificent puzzle packs[/b] (200+ puzzles)[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/957760/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy_The_Greatest_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/957761/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy_Classic_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/957762/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy_Speed_Pack/

[i]Thanks for your support,
Konstructors team[/i]

notes.title: Sudoku Universe + Killer (50% OFF) / Weeklong deal
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/861270/Sudoku_Killer/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32988905/cc3524b7e1291fd3d869e5b559c3cef3c281cd45.png[/img][/url]

Hey everyone! We're finally live. 
3rd game in our best Sudoku series on Steam is available for download.

Base price $1.99, but you can get it with 50% discount if already have Sudoku Universe (weeklong deal).

[h1]Features[/h1]
Recommended for all Sudoku and puzzles fans. Grab large cup of coffee, get yourself comfortable and go for 50+ hours of mind-teasing experience. 

Killer Sudoku puzzles include all the rules of regular Sudoku but add in dashed-line 'cages' which must sum to given values. Killer Sudoku is also sometimes known as Sumdoku, Mathdoku or Addoku.
[list]
[*] 100 killer Sudoku Killer puzzles
[*] Level's progress save
[*] Beautiful minimalist design, multiple color themes
[*] 10 ambient relaxing soundtracks
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Trading Cards, Badge, Emoticons and Backgrounds (Coming soon)
[*] Cross-platform Steam Cloud saves
[*] As always - Windows, Mac and Linux support
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8845/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32988905/9d1e67945c2d24e80cc890a0f5f11b4f73235b3f.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Bought a game? Write review[/h1]
Each review, positive or negative, provides so important for us feedback; moreover, it gives more visibility for game among Steam recommendation system, which can boost our sales. 

[h1]Become a backer[/h1]
So even with a few words, you can show us your support and help us make our future games. If you like our previous projects, don't hesitate and buy [b]Sudoku Killer[/b] - each copy funds our company and gives us ability to create better games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/861270/Sudoku_Killer/

notes.title: Your recommendations
notes.content:
Hey guys,
I want to continue updating this game and would love to hear your thoughts and recommendations.

Main "hate" source - achievements. Explanation why i made them:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/724740/discussions/0/1620599015877406561/
Obviously, I can't just remove them now, cause it will bring even more hate. Sorry, but hope for understanding.

Currently, my TODO list for the next update:
1. rework UI ( M S Q C buttons, etc.), so it'll be clear what every button do.
2. ability to turn on/off achievements totally
3. ability to show achievements after game closed (not during a game)
4. divide current levels into chapters + add new levels

Would appreciate your ideas.

notes.title: Minor update - Hotkeys, color theme switch, 32-bit support, bug fixes.
notes.content:
[h1]- Hotkeys[/h1]
[b]C[/b] - switch color theme.
[b]L[/b] - lock/unlock color theme (if you want to play always with one pre-selected theme).
[b]M[/b] - music on/off.
[b]S[/b] - sounds on/off.
[b]Q[/b] - quit from level (if on level screen) / game (if on level selection screen).

[h1]- Windows/Mac/Linux 32-bit support[/h1]

[h1]- Removed Steam overlay opening[/h1]

[h1]- Fixed cursor moving on Linux[/h1]

[h1]- Fixed Linux launch bug[/h1] If still not working, find executable on your hard drive and do "chmod +x lines.x86" and "chmod +x lines.x86_64".

Thank you everybody for support and feedback. 

Best regards,
Nestor Yavorskyy
